decisions.decision: Scope Phase 27 to typography-only; keep palette, badge composition, coord row unchanged
decisions.rationale: User wanted a focused first pass; broader theming deferred

decisions.decision: Drop coloured badge fill + rollover stripe overlay after UAT
decisions.rationale: User feedback on shipped slate: 'we don't need the colour around the event type'. Kept function signature stable so callers are zero-touch.

decisions.decision: Drop AU state suffix entirely (Narellan, NSW -> NARELLAN)
decisions.rationale: User wanted a ranked-location feel; the state abbreviation felt redundant at hero weight

decisions.decision: Bundle Cinzel TTFs in-tree under SIL OFL 1.1 via pyproject.toml package-data glob
decisions.rationale: No fonts-cinzel apt package exists; Raspberry Pi OS does not ship it
